notes:
I found two operators with preschool swim lessons in Oakville, plus a private swim school. I couldn't find a posted fall day, time or price for any of them.

**1. Town of Oakville, Learn to Swim Parent and Tot / Preschool.** 
The Town offers lessons under the Lifesaving Society Swim for Life program
, and 
its swimming programs run at Iroquois Ridge Community Centre, Glen Abbey Recreation Centre and River Oaks Community Centre
. The booking page's published age band wasn't readable, so I haven't confirmed an age fit. 
Fall registration opened Tuesday, August 11 at 7 a.m.
, so fall is already underway. 
Winter registration opens Tuesday, December 1 at 7 a.m.
 The schedule and price sit in their booking system, and I couldn't read them.

**2. YMCA of Oakville, YMCA Preschool Swim Lessons.** 
For children between 3 to 5 years old.
 
Swim lessons run in 12-week sessions with a one-week break between sessions.
 No fall day, time or price was on the page I read.

**3. Goldfish Swim School – Oakville.** 
Lessons are designed for children ages 4 months through 12 years old, in an indoor setting.
 
It lists preschool swim programs.
 No schedule or price was on that page.
